designNotes: Round-robin with turn weights; reassignment after 60 working minutes; boundary on working hours 08:30–20:30.

cases.title: Leads are dealt by turn weight

steps.action: Give consultant A weight 2 and B weight 1, then create 3 leads
steps.expected: A receives 2 leads and B receives 1

cases.manualReason: Changes shared assignment settings and needs several users.

cases.title: A lead untouched for 60 working minutes moves to the next consultant, inside 08:30–20:30 only

steps.action: Leave a lead untouched for 60 working minutes
steps.expected: It moves to the next consultant and the move is in its history

steps.action: Create a lead at 20:00 and leave it
steps.expected: It does not move before 08:30 the next working day

testConditions: a lead at 20:00 does not move at 21:00
cases.manualReason: Depends on time passing; needs a controllable clock.
